newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FAA seeks security penalty from Delta.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FAA seeks security penalty from Delta.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration on Friday said it was seeking $52,000 in civil penalties from Delta Air Lines Inc for inadequate security procedures in Lisbon, Portugal.
Delta failed to maintain accurate and complete training records and to provide proper training, testing and evaluation of security personnel in Lisbon, the FAA said.
The violation was identified in an FAA inspection on July 26, 1995. Upon notification Delta made full corrective action, the FAA said.
Delta discontinued service to Portugal in November 1996.
